name: Men-nefer

categories.label: Prestige Points (PP) on score track after Era III Harvest
categories.labelVi: Điểm Prestige (PP) trên track sau Harvest Era III
categories.hint: Read the final PP from the score track. Era-end scoring (Obelisk, Necropolis, Pyramids track, Duat, Trade Contracts, Queens' Pyramids permissions) is already added to the track by then.

categories.label: Heart + Feather space values (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Tổng giá trị ô Heart + Feather (hòa điểm)
categories.hint: Add the values of the spaces where your Heart and Feather stand; higher wins a PP tie.

tiebreakers.description: Purest of heart: highest sum of the values of the Heart and Feather spaces
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. PP are scored at the end of each of 3 Eras (Harvest phase, red seals) and immediately (purple seals); the game ends after the Era III Harvest and the winner has most PP. PP never drop below 0. Harvest order: Obelisk, Necropolis, Pyramids track, Duat, Trade Contracts, Queens' Pyramids permissions. Solo mode has its own rulebook (not modelled).
